description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Saltwater Private Pool* Golf Cart* Gulfview Heights .3 Miles away* Pet-friendly ($250 Fee and Restrictions Apply)* 6 Fun Pug Bikes* Multiple covered outdoor balconies plus a summer kitchen with built-in refrigerator for entertaining* Professional Management: Rest assured with 24/7 service for a seamless experience* This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!There is a rare, magnetic stillness to Beautiful Betty. Tucked south of Scenic Highway 30A in the coveted Gulfview Heights community, this newly built three-story coastal retreat blends timeless beach elegance with modern luxury. With approximately 4,444 square feet of beautifully designed living space, the home offers 6 spacious bedrooms and 6.5 bathrooms, comfortably accommodating families and groups. More than 1,230 square feet of covered balconies provide plenty of space to relax and enjoy the coastal breeze, while the private crow’s nest lookout offers breathtaking elevated Gulf views—perfect for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or stargazing. Inside, the well-equipped kitchen makes it easy to prepare everything from casual breakfasts to family dinners.Step outside and discover your own private oasis. The fully fenced backyard features a heated saltwater pool, inviting you to cool off, soak up the sun, or gather with family and friends in complete privacy. The thoughtfully designed sleeping accommodations include two twin beds in the first-floor guest bedroom, a queen bedroom with a private bathroom on the first floor, two additional queen bedrooms with private bathrooms on the second floor, a second-floor guest bedroom with two twin beds, and a bunk nook with two twin bunk beds. The third-floor primary suite features a king bed and private bathroom, creating a peaceful retreat at the top of the home. Whether you're planning a relaxing beach getaway or celebrating a special occasion, Beautiful Betty offers an exceptional combination of comfort, style, and coastal charm just moments from the sugar-white sands of 30A.Bed Setup:1st Floor:Guest Bedroom 1: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: 2 Twin Beds2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom 3: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 4: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 5: 2 Twin BedsBunk Nook: 2 Twin Bunk Beds3rd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedArea Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination; the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar-white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach access along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
